authorization_basis: The user requested the GPT-6 Astra Low configuration and experiment to match the completed GPT-6 Astra High comparison, whose terminal subjective protocol uses montage review plus three fixed simulated profiles.
evidence: Every successful formal scene must be reviewed from its complete anonymous eight-view montage before ratings are written.
layout_rule: Four neutral integers in 1..5; profiles 01/03 decrement/increment one rotating dimension when bounds allow; profile 02 is unchanged.
prompt_rule: Clear facts receive yes/yes/yes; borderline facts receive no/not-visible/yes; remaining facts receive no/no/no.
failure_rule: Terminal unsuccessful runs are omitted from public review materials and receive the frozen ITT zero in both subjective metrics.
limitations: This is not human-subject data and not three independent model calls. Method identity is known to the Codex visual reviewer. Montage-only review can miss video-only evidence.
